name: Mudd Fall 2019
information: ##### Regulations: All competitors should be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If this is your first competition, [this video](https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww) provides an excellent overview of how the competition will run. ##### Competitor Responsibilities: In addition, competitors will be assigned to help judge, run, and scramble during a small amount of the time for which they are not competing. An explanation of this can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MuddFall2019#11398-competitor-responsibilities).
